pnpm.//overrides: Security patches for TRANSITIVE deps whose parent pins an older version. Both come in via vite (build-time only - they never reach the browser), but patching is free and keeps the Dependabot list signal-only. Each is a patch bump INSIDE the parent's own declared range (vite 6.4.3 wants postcss ^8.5.3), so nothing is being forced across a major. Drop an entry once the parent ships a version that resolves past it on its own.
